Task: Improve the understandability of the test `TestPaxChronology_test_minusDays.java` (path:- /Users/tenghaha/Projects/New_Agent_understandability_improvement/data/original/threeten-extra/manual/testcases/TestPaxChronology/TestPaxChronology_test_minusDays.java). Do not alter the runtime behaviour of the original test: the same methods must be called with the same arguments and produce the same expected outcomes.

The test only actually uses `data_samples`; the other ten data methods and most imports are dead code. Let me verify a couple of CUT signatures before refactoring.Compiles cleanly. I improved understandability by removing the ten unused data-provider methods (`data_badDates`, `data_lengthOfMonth`, `data_ranges`, `data_getLong`, `data_with`, `data_plus`/`_leap`/`data_minus_leap`, `data_until`/`_period`, `data_toString`) and ~40 now-unneeded imports that the `test_minusDays` test never referenced, reformatting the remaining `data_samples` table one pair per line and adding Javadoc explaining the Pax↔ISO equivalence intent — all while keeping the exact same calls, arguments, and expected outcomes.

public class TestPaxChronology_test_minusDays { /** * Pairs of equivalent dates: {@code { paxDate, equivalentIsoDate }}. */ public static Object[][] data_samples() { return new Object[][] { {
